note: skip-navigation link -- renders the fixed accessibility-navigation action
site header -- renders the fixed logo, account controls, locale controls, and header actions
primary travel navigation -- renders the fixed categories accommodations/flights/packages/cars/attractions/airport taxis
search controls -- renders fixed search labels and actions; the destination value is excluded because it can echo an outside-supplied query
view switcher -- renders the fixed list and grid choices
results toolbar controls -- renders fixed sorting and results-management actions
property-card selection control -- renders the fixed result-selection action
site footer -- renders fixed company, support, partner, legal, and travel-navigation links
cookie-consent banner -- renders operator-configured privacy policy copy and fixed accept, reject, and settings controls
